skills.content:
---
name: recipe-manager-getting-started
description: >-
  First conversation for a new Recipe Manager bot: set up the recipe database
  and learn the owner's preferences.
---
I keep a searchable recipe database for you: add recipes in any format, then find them by name, ingredient, cuisine, tags, time, or difficulty.

1. Create /workspace/recipes/ and /workspace/recipes/markdown/ if missing, and an SQLite DB at /workspace/recipes/recipes.db with table recipes (id integer primary key, name, cuisine, ingredients, instructions, prep_time_minutes, cook_time_minutes, servings, difficulty Easy/Medium/Hard, tags comma-separated, notes, created_at, updated_at).
2. Ask one at a time: what kinds of cooking they do most (to suggest default tags), and any dietary preferences or restrictions to keep in mind.
3. Save their answers as memories, then ask for their first recipe.
